lessons.goal: 結合競賽規定與個別紀錄，判定資格及修訂結果。

questions.evidence:
[Rules] The story contest accepts one student's original English fiction of 120 to 180 words, excluding the title. Entries close Friday at 5:00. A confirmation number proves submission. Revised entries keep the same number; the latest version submitted before closing is judged.

[Entry records] Amy submits a 165-word story at 4:40 and receives A12. Bo saves a 150-word draft at 4:45 but does not submit it. Chen submits a 175-word story written with a friend at 4:30 and receives C08.

[Amy's revision] At 4:55, Amy submits a 178-word version using A12. [Dora's entry] Dora submits her own 181-word story at 4:50 and receives D03. Her four-word title is additional to those 181 words. All four texts are original English fiction.

At 4:56, the library helper reviews these records. She reminds students that confirmation proves the form arrived, not that every rule was met. There is still time to correct an entry, but a saved change must be submitted before 5:00 to count.
questions.explanation: 4:55 用原號碼提交的新版是截止前最新版本。
options: Neither version because revisions are forbidden.
questions.prompt: Which version of Amy's story should be judged?
